title.en: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng vệ tinh Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy tại Đô thị San Jacinto, Tỉnh Ticao Island, Tỉnh Masbate, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานดาวเทียม Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ ในเทศบาล San Jacinto จังหวัด Ticao Island จังหวัด Masbate และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Satelit Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler di Kotamadya San Jacinto, Provinsi Ticao Island, Provinsi Masbate, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Satelit Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah Biasa di Perbandaran San Jacinto, Wilayah Ticao Island, Wilayah Masbate, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The satellite office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) located in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, is hereby converted into a regular district office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the regular LTO District Office in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Province of Masbate, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the LTO Satellite Office in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
